text: You are on the support-desk app in this directory. Add a front desk agent. In `src/agents.ts`, add and export `triage`, the agent customers talk to first. It hands order questions to `orderAgent` and refund requests to `refundAgent` instead of answering them itself. A conversation with it can be picked up again later by its session id, so a customer who said "My order is A-1001." can ask "What is its status?" in a later request. Export `triage` from `src/index.ts`. Callers start a conversation with `triage.chat()` and `send(message)`, read the `sessionId` from the response, and continue it with `triage.loadChat({ sessionId })`. Keep the existing flows and their exports. Don't change `package.json` or add dependencies.
